purpose: Integrator re-run, after rustfmt, of the checks the thin-cli I6/V1/V2 slice reported, in the agent worktree at its final commit.
script_source:
#!/bin/bash
# Independent re-run of the thin-cli slice's executed checks, after formatting, in the agent's worktree.
cd /home/brittonr/.cargo-target/agents-20261030/thin-cli
V=/home/brittonr/.cargo-target/agents-20261030/validation/thin-cli
W="python3 /home/brittonr/.cargo-target/mantle-complete-20261026-9ar4jfgk/run-in-worktree-v1.py --worktree $PWD/worktree --scratch $PWD/scratch --"
git -C worktree rev-parse HEAD > $V/head.txt; git -C worktree status --short > $V/status-before.txt
run() { name=$1; shift; echo "== $name: $*" > $V/$name.log; $W "$@" >> $V/$name.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> $V/$name.log; }
run v-fmt cargo fmt --check -p mantle
run v-cli cargo test --locked --offline -p mantle --test gateway_cli --test profile_cli --test cargo_build_bundle_cli --test release_gauntlet_cli -- --test-threads 1
run v-foreign-cli cargo test --locked --offline -p mantle --test foreign_import_cli -- --test-threads 1
run v-foreign-unit cargo test --locked --offline -p mantle --bin mantle foreign_import_cmd::tests -- --test-threads 1
run v-arch-self cargo -Zscript scripts/check-cli-architecture.rs --self-test
run v-arch cargo -Zscript scripts/check-cli-architecture.rs
git -C worktree status --short > $V/status-after.txt
echo done > $V/DONE
